returnPolicy.title: Return Policy
returnPolicy.content: Return Policy Customers have the right to return a product if it is delivered in a damaged condition. To initiate the return process, please follow these steps: Notification Period: We kindly ask customers to notify us of any damaged product's return policy on the same delivery date. This allows us to address the issue promptly and ensure a timely resolution. Return Registration: To initiate the return process, please send an email to MFASPORTSMAHE@GMAIL.COM or contact us at 9074694968 with the necessary details, including the order number, product name, and description of the damage. Exchange or Replacement Should you require an exchange or replacement for the damaged item, our customer service team is available to assist you. We recommend contacting us on the date of delivery itself to expedite the process. Our team can be reached at 9074694968 during our business hours from 10 a.m. to 7 p.m. (except Sundays). We don't have an exchange for the Offer Section Jersey,Shorts & Boots. Important Notes .Please ensure that the product remains unused, in its original packaging, and accompanied by the original invoice to facilitate the return process. . Upon contacting us, our team will guide you through the necessary steps and provide instructions on returning the damaged product. . We value your satisfaction and are committed to resolving any issues with your purchase promptly. Thank you for choosing us for your sports equipment needs.
points: 7-day return window from date of delivery.
Eligible if product has manufacturing defects or damaged on delivery.
Contact Customer Support at +91 90746 94968 with unboxing photo/video.

shippingPolicy.title: Shipping Policy
shippingPolicy.content: Shipping Policy Standard Shipping Dispatch Time : All non-customized products will be dispatched within 2 business days of placing your order. Delivery Time : Standard delivery within India is expected to take approximately 7 days from the date of dispatch. Customised Products Dispatch and Delivery Time: Customised products, crafted with precision and tailored to your preferences, will be dispatched and delivered within 15 business days of placing your order placement anywhere in India. We understand the anticipation, and we assure you that the extra time is dedicated to ensuring the highest quality in every detail of your personalised item. Tracking Your Order You will receive tracking details via email or SMS, allowing you to monitor the progress of your shipment efficiently. Delivery Charges Shipping costs may vary based on your location and the weight of your order. You can view the shipping charges during the checkout process before finalising your purchase.
points: Non-customized products dispatched within 2 business days.
Free Delivery all over India for orders above Rs 399.
Standard transit time 4-7 working days depending on destination pincode.
